summary: VERIFIED: ON PAR at 8.1/10 (reviewer 8.2, first closing 8.0). No blocker. One confirmed major (item icon art unchanged; backlog under ruling 8) and five confirmed minors. Verification: re-ran `node _harness/icon_probe.mjs --out _harness/_reports/closing2_hudv_icon_probe.json` (OK; items 38 px p50 median 74/min 66, p95 min 192, fill median 0.47 = identical to closing_hud_verify_icon_probe.json); `git log -- content/ui/icons/items` last change 69c4cd074 on 2026-10-29, before the first closing, so the art is truly unchanged. The only src/ui change since the reviewer's captures (f0eb3ef00) touches app.tsx/loading.tsx/state.ts, not the HUD, so the reviewer's 15:06 captures represent the current build. overlay_regress log ends 'overlay_regress: PASS' (B1 node counts 2723 before/after, interiorShare 0; M10 17/17 drawn). Code checks for every minor reproduce (hud.css:515/518, combat.ts:108-122, model.ts:604/621, capture_c multikill seq). One reviewer detail is wrong: the shop's suggested row (closing2_hud_B10_shop.png) is not 'five red blade or pick tiles'; it is blade (red), boots (brown), spear (blue), mail (grey), pick (red), hammer (yellow), and those silhouettes read. The unreadable cases are in the 38 px inventory (slots 1 Shadowpin, 2, 3). Score shaved 0.1 because both owner-flagged surfaces (item art, minimap chart art) are unchanged since the first closing. Load 12-90 during verification: no timing claims.

findings.title: Item icon art unchanged since the first closing; several items are smudges at the 38 px slot
findings.what: No item icon has changed since 2026-10-29. In the live inventory (4x crop) slot 1 Shadowpin reads as a white blob with purple strokes, slot 2 is a busy yellow tangle, slot 3 an indistinct bowl; median subject fill 0.47. Kept major because the owner explicitly asked for much better item images and nothing was done; the first closing rated it minor (hud-c6) before that ask. Correction: the shop's suggested row is not five red tiles, its silhouettes (blade, boots, spear, mail, pick, hammer) read; the problem is concentrated in detailed or small-subject icons and within the 19-item Strike family.
findings.evidence: Verifier re-run: node _harness/icon_probe.mjs --out _harness/_reports/closing2_hudv_icon_probe.json -> items 38 px p50 med 74/min 66, p95 min 192, fill med 0.47 (identical to closing_hud_verify_icon_probe.json). git log -- content/ui/icons/items: last 69c4cd074 2026-10-29. Shots _harness/_shots/closing2_hud_Z_items_4x.png, closing2_hud_B10_shop.png.
findings.gauge: LoL item icons fill the square with one dominant subject and rim light, readable by silhouette at slot size.
findings.fix: Repaint in VALE's chalk-and-lamplight style every item with fill < 0.55 (prioritise Strike family and Shadowpin): one bold object at >= 65 % fill, warm rim light, distinct shape per item; add icon_probe minimum fill 0.6 and an in-family pairwise distance floor.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced (identical numbers, unchanged files). Severity held at major given the owner's explicit ask; suggested-row claim in the reviewer's text was inaccurate.

findings.title: Minimap chart art still a flat survey diagram; grouped portraits merge
findings.what: Function is LoL-tier, but the chart is flat grey lanes and dark discs, and 3-4 portraits at the bottom lane overlap into one cluster.
findings.gauge: LoL's minimap is a painted miniature of the terrain; grouped icons stay legible.
findings.fix: Bake a posterized top-down render of the RIFT terrain with chalk wall edges; fan portraits within one radius by 6-8 px.

findings.title: Death recap damage-type chips overflow their 20 px pills
findings.what: Label and value wrap onto two lines outside the pill, even for 'Physical 217'.
findings.gauge: LoL's recap split is clean single-line figures.
findings.fix: .dchip white-space: nowrap; flex: none; .recap__types flex-wrap: wrap; abbreviate large values.

findings.title: Team wipe banner beats the player's own four-takedown; queue runs 10.5 s
findings.what: Same rank 4, first-come wins: 'Lamps out' at 149 ms, 'Four tolls' 3.5 s, 'Blazing' 7.0 s, clear 10.5 s.
findings.gauge: LoL calls the player's multikill before the ace; bursts resolve in a few seconds.
findings.fix: Rank multikill n at n+0.5 or break ties toward the player's banner; fold the same-tick streak into the multikill sub.

findings.title: Floating damage number spawns over the enemy HP bar
findings.gauge: LoL damage numbers drift from the body clear of the bar.
findings.fix: Spawn at chest height with alternating lateral offset, or layer bars above numbers.
findings.verifierNote: Seen in crop; one frame, so frequency unmeasured.

findings.title: Overkill counted in Damage stat and death recap
findings.what: Stats and recap log use raw amount, not HP removed; bounded by one hit in real play.
findings.evidence: src/sim/combat.ts:108-110 hp clamp, :115 damageToFighters += amount, :118 damageTaken += amount, :121 dmgLog amount.
findings.gauge: LoL damage figures are trusted for comparing players.
findings.fix: Use min(amount - shielded, hpBefore) + shielded for stats and log; keep amount for the floater.
findings.verifierNote: Code confirms; inflated numbers in the shots came from injected hits.
